subject: Hosted API pricing qualification: monthly tokens + peak TPS
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing - follow up & token volumes

Hi Jane,

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Use case: chat-based product assistant (mostly short Q/A with contextual history) + occasional batch embedding jobs for ranking.
- Primary ask: we need your expected monthly token volume and peak TPS so we can build a cost model and recommend the right hosted configuration.

Could you confirm the following by EOD Tuesday if possible?
1) Expected monthly token volume (initial / 6mo / 12mo)
2) Peak TPS requirement (interactive chat peak, and any background embedding throughput)
3) Target unit economics (what $/1M tokens would be acceptable for you) or a monthly budget range

I've attached a short pricing overview to give you a baseline of hosted API unit prices and examples. Once you share numbers we can run a quick model and recommend whether Hosted API or Redwood Dedicated makes more sense long term.

Thanks — happy to schedule a 30-min pricing call as a follow-up.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmeretail.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, procurement <procurement@acmeretail.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing - follow up & token volumes

Hi Ben / team,

Thanks for the demo — this looks promising. A quick pass on numbers from our product/finance side: 

- Initial expected monthly tokens: ~150M tokens (chat + small embedding volume)
- 6mo target: 500M tokens / month
- 12mo plan: 1.2B tokens / month (if adoption ramps as expected)

Peak TPS (chat): we see spikes during business hours when customers are active. Expect peak bursts around 10-15 TPS for interactive chat (short-lived, <5min bursts). Background embedding/batch ranking peaks are lower — 2-4 TPS when running nightly jobs.

Target unit economics: our procurement team is looking for a ballpark of $8-12 per 1M tokens for a hosted solution. Initial monthly budget we can cover $1.5k-2k; we expect to increase spend if the product metrics track. Important: please show both pay-as-you-go and a committed/discounted tier in your model.

I attached a small estimates spreadsheet with our MAU/usage assumptions. Happy to jump on a 30-min call this week to walk through the numbers.

Best,
Jane
Jane Doe
VP Product, Acme Retail
jane.doe@acmeretail.com
[Attachment: acme_mau_estimates.xlsx (xlsx, 34KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing - follow up & token volumes

Thanks Jane — that's really helpful. Quick notes / clarifying Qs: 

- Confirming numbers: 150M initial, growth to ~1.2B in 12mo. We'll run a three-scenario model (conservative / expected / aggressive) showing costs at current hosted list, and at stepped committed discounts.
- TPS: when you say 10-15 TPS peak for chat, is that the absolute peak observed in the spreadsheet or the expected sustained peak during business hours? We model cost and capacity differently for short bursts vs sustained load.
- Unit economics: we'll show both $/1M token examples and the monthly totals for the scenarios (e.g., 150M @ $10/1M = $1,500/mo). We'll also include an example of committed pricing (e.g., ~$6-7/1M at commit levels >1B tokens/month) so you can see tradeoffs.

Next steps:
1) I'll drop a short cost model into the shared Drive and send a proposed timeslot for a 30-min call.
2) If procurement wants terms/SOW/SLAs early, Marissa can loop in the contract template and timeline.

Link to HubSpot deal (so we can attach your spreadsheet to the record): https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/ACME-2026-042
Drive calc (private): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-pricing-calc

Would later-day Wed or Thu work for a 30-min review?

Cheers,
Ben

Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing - follow up & token volumes

Hi Jane — really appreciate the detail. A couple items from the contract/ops side that will help speed things: 

- SLA needs (latency P95 targets) and whether the traffic can tolerate occasional model-fallbacks during peak.
- Any specific compliance requirements (PII, data residency) — if you have a security questionnaire we can fill it out.
- Target go-live date (this helps size ramp + trial credits).

We will prepare: 
- A short cost model showing pay-as-you-go and committed tiers for 150M / 500M / 1.2B tokens.
- A proposed three-month pilot credit and a sample MSA for procurement to review.

I can join the pricing call and bring a procurement checklist. Looking at availability — Thu 18 Mar 2026 11:00-11:30 PT or Fri 19 Mar 09:00-09:30 PT.

Best,

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing - follow up & token volumes

Quick internal note

We can comfortably support 15 TPS burst on Hosted API for the chat workload described (short context windows). For sustained loads above ~8-10 TPS we recommend exploring Dedicated pools or a hybrid routing policy (hosted for most traffic + Dedicated for steady high-throughput workloads).

I'll include latency P95 numbers and a cost delta between hosted and Dedicated in the pricing deck Ben is preparing. If Jane's 12mo number (~1.2B tokens/month) is on-track, committed Dedicated pricing will likely be materially cheaper.

Thanks,
Alex
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
